No canonical reading registry exists in audited name sources. Kanji readings are not inferred as official.

Static source audit does not prove an already-open browser has refreshed assets. index.html loads versioned master before versioned script; no independent dex name store is used for current unlocked species.
Saved household partner label / life-log snapshots can preserve historical text; dex partner labels use current ALL_PARTNER_CANDIDATES. Keep historical saves and IDs intact.

The 14 VERSION7 candidates are not approved renames. Some have no exact current-main entity-label match; three proposal keys belong to PR498 candidate cards, outside official452. Similarity to illness/transformation/etc is not identity.

fields.formalName: authoritative current display spelling per game context; do not silently choose across 19 divergences
fields.reading: nullable, explicitly reviewed kana; no runtime auto-transliteration
fields.species: stable species ID; null for non-species
fields.stage: 1..8; convert at boundary to existing saved 0..7 stageIndex

registryProposal.savePolicy: No stable ID, saved stageIndex, discoveredStages key, cardId, historical replay or snapshot migration.
